name: StandardBounties
title: The bounty board in the empty square
tagline: The town moved on. A few people still pin notes to the board, and 83 ether still sleeps in the box.

chapters.heading: A board for honest work
paragraphs: StandardBounties was born on the 18th of December 2017, in block 4,756,336, in the Byzantium age.
Anyone could post a task with a reward, and anyone could fulfil it and be paid.

chapters.heading: The busy years
paragraphs: The chain counts 19,461 transactions and 4,875 token transfers. Its site, bounties.network, was first archived in September 2017.

chapters.heading: The knocking
paragraphs: The crowds left, but the board stayed. In 2025 someone still knocked seven times.
The latest knock came on the 29th of October 2026: killBounty. Someone closing an old promise, perhaps. 83.001304 ether still sleeps inside.
